summary: Pre-alpha: per-user Host with IPC v1 and named Terminals (new, ls, attach, detach, rename, stop, kill, rm), one window and pane each; no GUI, splits or recovery yet

commands.name: new
commands.summary: Create a named Terminal running a program (resolved on its PATH, never through a shell; or one verbatim command line) in its own pseudo console and job; starts a Host on demand

commands.name: ls
commands.summary: Every Terminal of the Host with its state, pid and clients; starts nothing (also `subak list`)

commands.name: info
commands.summary: One Terminal with its window and pane; exit 3 when there is none

commands.name: status
commands.summary: The Host (or that none runs), every Terminal and every client in one answer; starts nothing

commands.name: attach
commands.summary: Interactive attach to a Terminal's pane in this terminal; Ctrl+B d detaches, Ctrl+C goes to the program, nothing is stopped

commands.name: detach
commands.summary: Detach every client of a Terminal, or one client by id; never stops a process

commands.name: rename
commands.summary: Rename a Terminal (unique, case-insensitive); its id never changes

commands.name: stop
commands.summary: End a Terminal's processes (graceful, then forced after 5 s) and keep it as stopped

commands.name: kill
commands.summary: End a Terminal's processes at once and remove the Terminal

commands.name: rm
commands.summary: Remove a Terminal that runs nothing; --force also ends a running one

commands.name: host.start
commands.summary: Start a detached per-user Host (one start lock per endpoint), optionally with a first Terminal

commands.name: host.status
commands.summary: Host process id, protocol, job breakaway, environment, idle grace, Terminals and clients

commands.name: host.health
commands.summary: Heartbeat: verify the Host's identity, complete the handshake and measure the answer time

commands.name: host.attach
commands.summary: Interactive attach to the Host's only running pane (as `subak attach` without a target)

commands.name: host.stop
commands.summary: Stop the Host; ending live Terminals needs --kill-terminals and consent

commands.name: host.serve
commands.summary: Run the Host in this process (what host start launches detached)
